prompt_template: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original fictional game-cover illustration for public emulator interface demonstrations. Create a polished portrait cover, 2:3 aspect ratio, full bleed. {scene} Premium editorial video game key art, striking silhouette, rich controlled contrast, meticulous detail, sophisticated composition. Title exactly "{TITLE}" in large beautifully spaced readable lettering in the upper quarter; small text "ORIGINAL DEMO ART" near the bottom. No console or publisher branding, no age-rating logos, no real game characters, no imitation of an existing franchise, no screenshots, no gameplay-performance claims. All scenery and characters must be original. This is illustrative sample artwork, not an actual game release.

concepts.title: NEON VECTOR
concepts.scene: An original aerodynamic silver hover racer curves through an elevated midnight circuit above a futuristic coastal city, electric cyan track lights, vivid magenta reflections, graphic speed streaks.

concepts.title: ORBIT ZERO
concepts.scene: A solitary original astronaut in an ivory pressure suit stands on a violet moon, a gigantic orange eclipsed planet above, delicate orbital rings and a distant geometric research outpost.

concepts.title: EMBER VALE
concepts.scene: An original small cloaked traveler with a lantern looks over a lush luminous green valley toward a warm amber ruined citadel, dramatic mountains, floating motes, painterly adventure.

concepts.title: PIXEL HORIZON
concepts.scene: A vivid original low-poly floating archipelago with crystalline waterfalls, coral red and turquoise geometric trees and a tiny original explorer, warm golden sunset, playful early 3D adventure energy.
